subtitle.en: From a trustworthy question to a defensible model
subtitle.zh: 从可信的问题到经得起检验的模型

description.en: Build intuition for learning from tabular data through eight original stories, transparent calculations, and primary-source reading. Each chapter connects a modeling decision to the evidence needed to justify it.
description.zh: 通过八个原创故事、清晰的计算和一手资料阅读，建立从表格数据中学习的直觉。每一章都把建模决策与支持它所需的证据联系起来。

coverage.en: Problem framing, leakage, regression, optimization, classification, evaluation, trees, unsupervised learning, and generalization. All stories and numerical datasets are original synthetic teaching examples.
coverage.zh: 涵盖问题定义、数据泄漏、回归、优化、分类、评估、树模型、无监督学习与泛化。所有故事和数值数据集均为原创的合成教学示例。

en: Read a table and distinguish rows from columns.
Work with averages, squares, fractions, and simple algebra.
Recognize a vector as an ordered list; derivative intuition is helpful but introduced here.
zh: 能够阅读表格并区分行与列。
掌握平均数、平方、分数和基础代数。
知道向量是有序数列；导数直觉会有帮助，本指南也会加以介绍。

en: Define a prediction task and prevent information leakage.
Calculate losses, gradient updates, classification metrics, and simple model decisions.
Explain what trees, clustering, and PCA learn and what they cannot establish.
Choose validation and regularization that match the intended deployment setting.
zh: 定义预测任务并防止信息泄漏。
计算损失、梯度更新、分类指标以及简单模型的决策。
解释树模型、聚类和主成分分析学到了什么，以及它们不能证明什么。
选择与预期使用场景相匹配的验证和正则化方法。

title.en: Define the question before dividing the data
title.zh: 划分数据之前，先定义问题

story.en: Mira wants a small field logger to warn when a sensor will fail during its next recording session. Her first table contains many sessions from the same twelve devices, plus a maintenance note written after each failure. A random row split produces an exciting score. Then a newly borrowed device performs badly, and Mira notices that the maintenance note practically reveals the answer. She rewrites the task: predict a future failure using only information available before a session begins. She removes the note and reserves complete devices for validation and testing because her intended use involves unfamiliar hardware. The score falls, but the remaining mistakes now describe a real challenge. Her notebook begins with the prediction time, the target, and the unit being held out. These decisions become part of the model, not preliminary paperwork.
story.zh: 米拉希望让一个小型野外记录器提前警告：传感器是否会在下一次记录任务中失效。她的第一张表包含同样十二台设备的许多次任务，还包括每次故障发生后写下的维护记录。随机按行划分数据后，分数令人兴奋。然而，一台新借来的设备表现很差，米拉也发现维护记录几乎直接揭示了答案。她重新定义任务：只使用任务开始前已经获得的信息，预测未来是否失效。她删除维护记录，并把完整的设备分别留作验证和测试，因为预期的使用场景涉及陌生硬件。分数下降了，但剩下的错误终于反映了真实挑战。她在笔记开头写下预测时点、目标，以及留出数据的单位。这些决策成为模型的一部分，而不只是前期文书工作。

concept.en: A supervised learning problem specifies an input, a target, and the moment when a prediction must be made. Training data fit parameters; validation data guide choices; test data estimate performance after those choices are fixed. Leakage occurs when the learning process gains information unavailable in the intended prediction setting. It includes future measurements, shared identities across an inappropriate split, and preprocessing fitted on held-out data. The split should represent the question: new devices require group separation, whereas future sessions on existing devices may require chronological separation.
concept.zh: 监督学习问题需要明确输入、目标和必须作出预测的时点。训练数据用于拟合参数，验证数据用于指导选择，测试数据则在这些选择确定之后评估性能。如果学习过程获得了预期预测场景中无法使用的信息，就会发生泄漏。这包括未来测量值、不恰当划分中跨集合重复出现的身份，以及使用留出数据拟合预处理步骤。划分方式应当对应研究问题：预测新设备需要按设备分组隔离，而预测现有设备的未来任务则可能需要按时间隔离。

application.en: Write one sentence naming the prediction unit, target horizon, and available features. Draw the route from raw records to the final score. Split before fitting imputation, scaling, or feature selection, and fit those steps within each training fold. Check duplicate records and shared entities. Keep a simple baseline and record the split rule so that later model comparisons answer the same question.
application.zh: 用一句话写清预测单位、目标时间范围和可用特征。画出从原始记录到最终分数的流程。在拟合缺失值填补、缩放或特征选择之前划分数据，并在每个训练折内拟合这些步骤。检查重复记录和跨集合共享的实体。保留一个简单基线，并记录划分规则，让后续模型比较回答同一个问题。

practice.en: The linked Google dataset-splitting tutorial explains the distinct roles of training, validation, and test data. The linked scikit-learn common-pitfalls guide demonstrates how preprocessing can leak information and uses pipelines to keep transformations with an estimator. Apply those documented workflows to an original sensor table: inspect feature timestamps, hold out the appropriate units, and verify that every learned transformation sees training rows only.
practice.zh: 所链接的 Google 数据集划分教程解释了训练、验证和测试数据各自的作用。所链接的 scikit-learn 常见陷阱指南演示了预处理如何泄漏信息，并使用流水线把数据转换与估计器结合起来。可以把这些已有文档中的流程用于自行构建的传感器表格：检查特征的时间戳，留出适当的单位，并确认每个需要学习的转换步骤只能看到训练行。

topics.formula:
D = D_train ⊔ D_val ⊔ D_test
R_test = (1 / n_test) Σ_{i=1}^{n_test} I[f(xᵢ) ≠ yᵢ]

symbols.en: D denotes the complete dataset; D_train, D_val, and D_test are its training, validation, and test subsets. The symbol ⊔ means a disjoint union of records, with any required group or time separation enforced as well. n_test is the number of test examples. The index i selects one test example, xᵢ is its available input, and yᵢ is its true class. f is the fixed trained classifier. I is an indicator that equals one for an incorrect prediction and zero otherwise. Σ adds these errors, and R_test is their average.
symbols.zh: D 表示完整数据集；D_train、D_val 和 D_test 分别表示训练、验证和测试子集。符号 ⊔ 表示记录互不重叠的并集，同时还必须满足所需的分组隔离或时间隔离。n_test 是测试样本数量。下标 i 指定一个测试样本，xᵢ 是其可用输入，yᵢ 是其真实类别。f 是已经训练并固定的分类器。I 是指示函数：预测错误时为一，否则为零。Σ 把这些错误相加，R_test 则是错误的平均值。

calculation.en: Construct 120 records from twelve devices, with ten sessions per device. Assign eight entire devices to training, two to validation, and two to testing. The resulting counts are 80, 20, and 20, and their sum is 120. Suppose the fixed classifier gets eighteen of the twenty test records right. There are two errors, so R_test = 2 / 20 = 0.10, or a 10% error rate. A separate, deliberately inappropriate row split might show nineteen correct predictions out of twenty, giving 5% error. That smaller number estimates a different, contaminated comparison if device identity carries information. Neither result proves performance on all future hardware. The two held-out devices, rather than twenty independent devices, also limit how much confidence this tiny demonstration deserves.
calculation.zh: 构造十二台设备的 120 条记录，每台设备对应十次任务。把八台完整设备用于训练，两台用于验证，两台用于测试。得到的记录数分别为 80、20 和 20，合计 120。假设固定后的分类器正确预测了二十条测试记录中的十八条，那么有两次错误，因此 R_test = 2 / 20 = 0.10，即错误率为 10%。另一个刻意采用不恰当按行划分的示例可能在二十条记录中预测正确十九条，得到 5% 的错误率。如果设备身份携带信息，这个更小的数字评估的是另一个受到污染的比较。两个结果都不能证明模型适用于所有未来硬件。此外，留出的其实是两台设备，而不是二十台独立设备，这也限制了这个微型演示值得给予的信心。

limits.en: Disjoint rows do not guarantee independent evidence. Related people, locations, recordings, or devices can cross a split without literal duplicates. A clean test set can still differ from future data. Small group counts make uncertainty especially large, and repeatedly selecting models using test results turns the test set into another validation set.
limits.zh: 记录互不重叠并不保证证据独立。相关的人、地点、录音或设备可能跨越不同集合，即使记录并非字面上的重复。干净的测试集仍可能与未来数据不同。分组数量很少时，不确定性尤其大；反复依据测试结果选择模型，会把测试集变成另一个验证集。

takeaway.en: A score becomes meaningful only after you specify what is predicted, when information becomes available, and what kind of unseen case the split represents.
takeaway.zh: 只有明确预测什么、信息何时可用，以及划分代表哪一种未见案例之后，分数才有意义。

title.en: Fit a line and account for every error
title.zh: 拟合直线，逐项核算误差

story.en: Jun records the height of seedlings beside a window and wants to estimate tomorrow's height from elapsed growing time. He draws a line through a scatterplot, but two plausible lines look equally convincing by eye. One follows most points closely and misses a tall seedling; the other moves toward that seedling and misses several ordinary ones. Instead of choosing the prettier line, Jun writes down every prediction and its difference from the measured height. Squaring and averaging those differences gives him an explicit rule for comparison. He also notices that the score is in squared centimeters, so he reports its square root alongside it. The exercise does not establish that time alone causes growth. It gives him a transparent baseline, a visible error pattern, and a reason to collect light measurements next.
story.zh: 俊记录窗边幼苗的高度，希望根据已生长的时间估计明天的高度。他在散点图上画了一条直线，但肉眼看来，两条候选直线都很有说服力。一条贴近大多数点，却偏离了一株较高的幼苗；另一条向那株幼苗靠近，却偏离了几株普通幼苗。俊没有选择看起来更漂亮的直线，而是逐项写下预测值及其与实测高度之差。对这些差值平方后取平均，他得到了明确的比较规则。他还注意到分数的单位是平方厘米，因此同时报告其平方根。这个练习不能证明仅有时间会导致生长，但它提供了透明的基线、可见的误差模式，以及下一步采集光照测量值的理由。

concept.en: Linear regression represents a numeric target as an intercept plus a weighted sum of features. In one dimension this is a line; with several features it is a plane or hyperplane. Mean squared error, or MSE, averages squared residuals and therefore gives large mistakes more influence than small ones. Minimizing it chooses parameters according to that particular preference. Residual plots can reveal curved patterns or changing error spread that a single average hides. A fitted coefficient describes a conditional association within the model, not automatically a causal effect.
concept.zh: 线性回归把数值目标表示为截距与特征加权和。在一维中，它是一条直线；使用多个特征时，它对应平面或超平面。均方误差（MSE）对残差的平方取平均，因此大误差的影响比小误差更强。最小化它，就是按照这种特定偏好选择参数。残差图可以显示单一平均值掩盖的弯曲模式或误差散布变化。拟合系数描述的是模型内部的条件关联，并不会自动成为因果效应。

application.en: Start with a constant prediction, such as the training target mean, and compare a linear model on the same held-out examples. Keep measurement units beside each feature and coefficient. Examine residuals against predictions and important inputs. If large errors dominate the result, inspect their provenance before changing the loss. Report a unit-preserving metric such as root mean squared error when communicating error magnitude.
application.zh: 先使用常数预测，例如训练目标的均值，再在相同的留出样本上比较线性模型。在每个特征和系数旁标注测量单位。检查残差相对于预测值及重要输入的图形。如果大误差主导结果，先检查其来源，再考虑更换损失函数。传达误差大小时，报告均方根误差这类保留原始单位的指标。

practice.en: The linked Google loss tutorial contrasts absolute and squared regression errors and explains how the choice changes the influence of large residuals. Its role here is to ground the loss definition, not supply the seedling story or numbers. Use the tutorial's comparison as a reading prompt, then calculate both metrics on your own measurements and explain which errors each metric emphasizes.
practice.zh: 所链接的 Google 损失教程比较了回归中的绝对误差与平方误差，并解释这种选择如何改变大残差的影响。这里引用它是为了支持损失的定义，幼苗故事和数值并非来自该教程。可以把教程中的比较作为阅读提示，然后针对自己的测量值计算两种指标，并说明每种指标更强调哪些错误。

topics.formula:
ŷᵢ = b + w xᵢ
MSE = (1 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (ŷᵢ − yᵢ)²
RMSE = √MSE

symbols.en: The index i identifies an observation and n is the number being evaluated. xᵢ is its input, yᵢ its measured target, and ŷᵢ the model prediction; the hat distinguishes an estimate from a measurement. b is the intercept, expressed in target units. w is the slope, expressed in target units per input unit. The difference ŷᵢ − yᵢ is a signed residual. Σ sums over all observations, the superscript 2 squares each residual, and √ takes a square root. MSE has squared target units; RMSE returns to target units.
symbols.zh: 下标 i 表示观测，n 是参与评估的观测数量。xᵢ 是输入，yᵢ 是实测目标，ŷᵢ 是模型预测；帽子符号用于区分估计值与测量值。b 是截距，单位与目标相同。w 是斜率，单位为每单位输入对应的目标单位。差值 ŷᵢ − yᵢ 是有正负号的残差。Σ 表示对所有观测求和，上标 2 表示对每个残差平方，√ 表示开平方。MSE 使用目标单位的平方，RMSE 则恢复为目标单位。

calculation.en: Use three synthetic observations with input days 1, 2, and 3 and heights 3, 5, and 8 centimeters. A candidate line with b = 1 and w = 2 predicts 3, 5, and 7. Its residuals are 0, 0, and −1 centimeters; the squared errors sum to 1, giving MSE = 1 / 3 ≈ 0.333 and RMSE ≈ 0.577 centimeters. A constant prediction equal to the target mean, 16 / 3, has squared errors 49 / 9, 1 / 9, and 64 / 9. Its MSE is 38 / 9 ≈ 4.222. The candidate line improves this comparison, but it is not claimed to be the least-squares optimum. These three training points also provide no independent estimate of future prediction quality.
calculation.zh: 使用三个合成观测：输入天数为 1、2、3，对应高度为 3、5、8 厘米。候选直线取 b = 1、w = 2，预测为 3、5、7。其残差为 0、0、−1 厘米；平方误差之和为 1，因此 MSE = 1 / 3 ≈ 0.333，RMSE ≈ 0.577 厘米。若常数预测等于目标均值 16 / 3，则平方误差为 49 / 9、1 / 9 和 64 / 9，其 MSE 为 38 / 9 ≈ 4.222。候选直线在这次比较中更好，但这里并未声称它是最小二乘最优解。这三个训练点也不能独立估计未来的预测质量。

limits.en: A straight line can miss nonlinear relationships, interactions, and abrupt changes. Squared loss is sensitive to extreme residuals, whether they reflect meaningful events or measurement errors. Extrapolating beyond the observed feature range can be unreliable. Correlated inputs can make individual coefficients unstable even when predictions remain useful.
limits.zh: 直线可能无法表达非线性关系、交互作用和突变。平方损失对极端残差敏感，无论这些残差反映的是有意义的事件还是测量错误。超出已观测特征范围的外推可能不可靠。相关输入可能使单个系数不稳定，即使预测仍然有用。

takeaway.en: Linear regression is a transparent baseline; its loss defines which mistakes matter, and its residuals reveal what the line leaves unexplained.
takeaway.zh: 线性回归是透明的基线；损失函数决定哪些错误更重要，残差则揭示直线尚未解释的部分。

title.en: Learn with controlled steps and comparable scales
title.zh: 用可控步长和可比尺度学习

story.en: Asha builds a model of how far a small robot cart travels during a motor pulse. One input is pulse duration in seconds, while another is an encoder count measured in thousands. Her training loss jumps upward after a few updates, and she initially assumes that the model is too simple. Before adding features, she inspects the update sizes and finds that one coefficient moves far more sharply than the other. She rescales the inputs using statistics from the training recordings and reduces the learning rate. The loss now descends steadily. To understand the change, she repeats one update by hand on two invented observations. That small calculation turns a mysterious training curve into a sequence of understandable decisions. She learns to separate an optimization problem from a model that genuinely lacks useful information.
story.zh: 阿莎建立一个模型，预测小型机器人小车在一次电机脉冲期间行驶多远。一个输入是以秒计的脉冲持续时间，另一个是以千为量级的编码器计数。几次更新后，训练损失突然上升，她起初以为模型过于简单。在增加特征之前，她检查了更新幅度，发现一个系数的变化比另一个剧烈得多。她使用训练记录的统计量缩放输入，并降低学习率，损失随后开始稳定下降。为了理解变化，她用两个虚构观测手算了一次更新。这个小计算把神秘的训练曲线变成了一系列可以理解的决策。她由此学会区分优化问题与模型确实缺少有用信息的问题。

concept.en: Gradient descent updates parameters in the direction opposite the local slope of the loss. The learning rate controls how far each step travels; too large a step can overshoot, while very small steps can be slow. Feature scaling changes the geometry of the optimization problem and can make a shared learning rate more workable. Standardization subtracts a training mean and divides by a training standard deviation. It changes units, not the information available. Convergence of training loss alone says nothing about leakage, causal meaning, or performance on new examples.
concept.zh: 梯度下降沿损失局部斜率的反方向更新参数。学习率控制每一步走多远；步长过大可能越过合适位置，步长很小则可能收敛缓慢。特征缩放会改变优化问题的几何形状，使统一的学习率更容易发挥作用。标准化先减去训练均值，再除以训练标准差。它改变的是单位，而不是可获得的信息。训练损失收敛本身并不能说明是否存在泄漏、是否具有因果含义，或在新样本上的表现如何。

application.en: Fit scaling statistics on training data and reuse them unchanged for validation and testing. Plot loss against updates, check for exploding or non-finite values, and try a smaller learning rate when steps are unstable. Compare training and validation curves before deciding whether to train longer. Handle constant features explicitly because their standard deviation is zero. Save the fitted transformation together with the final model.
application.zh: 在训练数据上拟合缩放统计量，并原样用于验证和测试。绘制损失随更新次数变化的曲线，检查数值是否爆炸或出现非有限值；若更新不稳定，可尝试更小的学习率。在决定延长训练之前，先比较训练曲线与验证曲线。对于标准差为零的常数特征，应明确处理。把拟合好的转换与最终模型一起保存。

practice.en: The linked Google gradient-descent tutorial follows repeated parameter updates and visualizes training loss. Its separate normalization tutorial discusses feature scales and their effect on optimization. Together they provide a documented route from a loss definition to a practical training diagnostic. Recreate the logic with the cart example below, then explain why the same numerical learning rate need not behave identically after changing input units.
practice.zh: 所链接的 Google 梯度下降教程追踪连续的参数更新，并展示训练损失。它的另一篇归一化教程讨论了特征尺度及其对优化的影响。两篇资料共同提供了一条有文档支持的路径，从损失定义走向实际训练诊断。可以用下面的小车示例重建其中的逻辑，再解释为何输入单位改变后，相同数值的学习率未必具有相同的表现。

topics.formula:
zᵢ = (xᵢ − μ_train) / s_train
L(w,b) = (1 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (w zᵢ + b − yᵢ)²
g_w = (2 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (w zᵢ + b − yᵢ) zᵢ
g_b = (2 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (w zᵢ + b − yᵢ)
w_new = w − η g_w; b_new = b − η g_b

symbols.en: xᵢ is raw input i; μ_train and s_train are the training mean and population standard deviation, with s_train positive. zᵢ is the standardized input and yᵢ the target. n counts training examples, and Σ sums over them. w and b are the current slope and intercept. L is mean squared loss. g_w and g_b are its partial derivatives with respect to those parameters. η is the positive learning rate. The suffix new marks the updated value. Both gradients are evaluated at the same old parameters before either update is applied.
symbols.zh: xᵢ 是第 i 个原始输入；μ_train 和 s_train 是训练均值与总体标准差，其中 s_train 为正。zᵢ 是标准化输入，yᵢ 是目标。n 是训练样本数量，Σ 表示对它们求和。w 和 b 是当前斜率与截距。L 是均方损失。g_w 和 g_b 分别是它关于这两个参数的偏导数。η 是正的学习率。后缀 new 表示更新后的值。在应用任一更新之前，两个梯度都必须在同一组旧参数上计算。

calculation.en: Take raw inputs 2 and 6, with targets 1 and 3. The training mean is 4 and the population standard deviation is 2, so standardized inputs are −1 and 1. Start with w = 0 and b = 0. Predictions are both zero, giving L = (1 + 9) / 2 = 5. The weight gradient is (2 / 2)[(−1)(−1) + (−3)(1)] = −2, and the intercept gradient is −4. With learning rate 0.1, simultaneous updates give w_new = 0.2 and b_new = 0.4. New predictions are 0.2 and 0.6, so the new loss is (0.64 + 5.76) / 2 = 3.2. One step reduces loss by 1.8; it does not finish optimization or demonstrate generalization.
calculation.zh: 取原始输入 2、6，对应目标为 1、3。训练均值为 4，总体标准差为 2，因此标准化输入为 −1、1。令初始参数 w = 0、b = 0。两个预测值都是零，得到 L = (1 + 9) / 2 = 5。权重梯度为 (2 / 2)[(−1)(−1) + (−3)(1)] = −2，截距梯度为 −4。学习率取 0.1，同时更新得到 w_new = 0.2、b_new = 0.4。新预测值为 0.2、0.6，因此新损失为 (0.64 + 5.76) / 2 = 3.2。这一步使损失下降了 1.8，但既没有完成优化，也不能证明泛化能力。

limits.en: Scaling does not repair mislabeled examples or missing explanatory variables. Standard deviation can be strongly affected by outliers. Gradient descent requires a suitable step size even for a convex objective; convexity alone does not make every update stable. More complex models may have nonconvex losses and different convergence behavior.
limits.zh: 缩放无法修复错误标签，也无法补上缺失的解释变量。标准差可能受到离群值的强烈影响。即使目标函数是凸函数，梯度下降仍需要合适的步长；凸性本身不能让每次更新都稳定。更复杂的模型可能具有非凸损失，收敛行为也会不同。

takeaway.en: Inspect the update rule, input units, and loss curve together; stable optimization is necessary for learning, but it is not evidence of generalization.
takeaway.zh: 把更新规则、输入单位和损失曲线放在一起检查；稳定优化是学习的必要条件，却不是泛化能力的证据。

story.en: Leo helps a backyard astronomy group decide whether to prepare cameras for a clear evening. He trains a classifier from weather measurements available before sunset and obtains values such as 0.35 and 0.72. A friend interprets these as final yes-or-no instructions, but Leo notices that the group has two different decisions. Setting out a portable camera is easy to reverse, while assembling a delicate tracking rig takes much longer. He keeps the same probability model and compares different decision thresholds on validation evenings. The portable camera can tolerate more false alarms; the tracking rig needs stronger evidence. They record the selected rule before checking the reserved test evenings. The lesson is that a probability estimate summarizes the model's belief, while a threshold expresses how a particular action will use that estimate.
story.zh: 利奥帮助一个后院天文小组决定，是否要为晴朗的夜晚准备相机。他使用日落之前可获得的天气测量值训练分类器，得到 0.35、0.72 这样的数值。一位朋友把这些数值理解成最终的“是或否”指令，但利奥发现，小组实际上要作出两种不同决策。摆出便携相机很容易撤回，而组装精密的跟踪装置则耗时得多。他保留相同的概率模型，在验证集的夜晚比较不同决策阈值。便携相机可以容忍更多误报，而跟踪装置需要更强的证据。他们在检查预留测试夜晚之前，先记录选定的规则。由此得到的教训是：概率估计概括了模型的判断，而阈值表达了某一种行动如何使用这个估计。

concept.en: Binary logistic regression maps a linear score through the sigmoid function to produce a number between zero and one. That number is interpreted as an estimated probability of the chosen positive class. A threshold converts the estimate into a class decision, but changing it does not retrain the model. Lowering the threshold generally includes more positive predictions; raising it includes fewer. Probability calibration is a separate question: predictions near 0.7 should correspond to roughly 70% positives over suitable repeated cases if the model is calibrated.
concept.zh: 二元逻辑回归把线性分数送入 sigmoid 函数，得到零与一之间的数值。这个数值被解释为所选正类的估计概率。阈值把估计转换为类别决策，但改变阈值并不等于重新训练模型。降低阈值通常会得到更多正类预测，提高阈值则会减少正类预测。概率校准是另一个问题：如果模型经过良好校准，那么在适当的重复案例中，预测接近 0.7 的案例应当大约有 70% 属于正类。

application.en: Name the positive class before training and keep that definition consistent in metrics. Use validation data to compare thresholds under the intended action costs or review capacity. Inspect both false positives and false negatives at the chosen operating point. If probabilities themselves inform decisions, check calibration as well as classification accuracy. Freeze the threshold before the final test, and document how ties at the threshold are handled.
application.zh: 在训练之前明确正类，并在各项指标中保持定义一致。根据预期行动的代价或人工审核能力，使用验证数据比较阈值。在选定的工作点同时检查假阳性与假阴性。如果概率本身会影响决策，除分类准确率外还应检查校准情况。在最终测试之前固定阈值，并记录概率恰好等于阈值时如何处理。

practice.en: The linked Google sigmoid tutorial explains how a linear score becomes a probability estimate. Its thresholding tutorial then connects probability cutoffs with confusion-matrix outcomes. Read these as two distinct stages of a classifier. In the original astronomy example, the model can remain fixed while the preparation rule changes; the official material supports that distinction without claiming any astronomy deployment or validating this invented dataset.
practice.zh: 所链接的 Google sigmoid 教程解释了线性分数如何变成概率估计。其阈值教程随后把概率分界点与混淆矩阵中的结果联系起来。可以把它们理解为分类器的两个不同阶段。在这个原创天文示例中，模型可以保持不变，而准备器材的规则可以改变；官方资料支持这种区分，并不意味着存在相应的天文部署，也没有验证这个虚构数据集。

topics.formula:
z = b + w x
p = 1 / (1 + exp(−z))
ŷ = I[p ≥ τ]

symbols.en: x is one measured feature, w its learned coefficient, and b the intercept. z is the resulting linear score, interpreted as the model's log-odds for the positive class. exp is the exponential function with base e, approximately 2.71828. p is the estimated probability of that positive class. τ is a chosen decision threshold between zero and one. ŷ is the predicted binary label. I equals one when the bracketed condition is true and zero otherwise; this convention assigns an exact threshold tie to the positive class.
symbols.zh: x 是一个测量特征，w 是学到的对应系数，b 是截距。z 是得到的线性分数，可解释为模型对正类的对数优势。exp 是以 e 为底的指数函数，e 约等于 2.71828。p 是正类的估计概率。τ 是选定的决策阈值，位于零与一之间。ŷ 是预测的二元标签。括号内条件成立时，I 等于一，否则等于零；这一约定把恰好等于阈值的情况归入正类。

calculation.en: Suppose an illustrative model uses b = −1.2, w = 0.8, and feature value x = 2. The linear score is z = −1.2 + 0.8 × 2 = 0.4. Since exp(−0.4) ≈ 0.6703, the estimated positive probability is 1 / 1.6703 ≈ 0.5987. With threshold 0.50, the model predicts the positive class; with threshold 0.65, it predicts the negative class. The probability and coefficients have not changed. For comparison, x = 0 gives z = −1.2 and p ≈ 0.2315. These are model outputs, not observed frequencies or guarantees about a particular evening. To justify either threshold, Leo would need labeled validation cases and an explicit preference between unnecessary preparation and missing a useful observing opportunity.
calculation.zh: 假设一个示范模型使用 b = −1.2、w = 0.8，特征值 x = 2。线性分数为 z = −1.2 + 0.8 × 2 = 0.4。由于 exp(−0.4) ≈ 0.6703，估计的正类概率为 1 / 1.6703 ≈ 0.5987。阈值取 0.50 时，模型预测正类；阈值取 0.65 时，模型预测负类。概率和系数都没有改变。作为对照，x = 0 时，z = −1.2，p ≈ 0.2315。这些都是模型输出，并非已观测频率，也不是对某一个夜晚的保证。若要证明任一阈值合理，利奥都需要带标签的验证案例，并明确如何权衡不必要的准备与错失合适观测机会。

limits.en: A sigmoid output is not automatically a well-calibrated probability. A linear decision boundary can miss important interactions unless the features represent them. Threshold preferences may change with class prevalence, action costs, or available capacity. Choosing a threshold on the test set contaminates the final evaluation just as choosing model parameters there would.
limits.zh: sigmoid 输出不会自动成为校准良好的概率。如果特征没有表达重要交互作用，线性决策边界就可能遗漏它们。类别比例、行动代价或可用能力改变时，合适的阈值也可能改变。在测试集上选择阈值，与在那里选择模型参数一样，都会污染最终评估。

takeaway.en: Train the probability model and choose the decision threshold as related but separate steps, then evaluate the complete rule on untouched data.
takeaway.zh: 把训练概率模型与选择决策阈值视为相关但独立的步骤，再用未参与选择的数据评估完整规则。

title.en: Count the mistakes that the task actually cares about
title.zh: 统计任务真正关心的错误

story.en: Tessa builds a detector for a rare frog call in long evening recordings. Most clips contain wind, insects, or silence, so a classifier that always says no call looks impressive when she checks accuracy. Listening to its selected clips reveals the problem: there are no selected clips at all. She labels a small evaluation collection and writes four counts on a sheet: calls found, calls missed, false alarms, and correctly rejected background. Now two models that seemed similar have visibly different behavior. One finds more calls but asks her to listen to many extra clips; another provides cleaner selections but misses quiet calls. Tessa chooses a validation criterion that matches the time available for listening and reports the missed-call count separately. Her evaluation becomes a description of scientific usefulness instead of a single flattering percentage.
story.zh: 泰莎建立一个检测器，在长时间夜间录音中寻找一种罕见的蛙鸣。大多数片段只有风声、昆虫声或寂静，所以当她检查准确率时，一个始终回答“没有蛙鸣”的分类器看起来表现出色。她想听听被选中的片段，却发现问题所在：根本没有任何片段被选中。她为一小组评估数据标注标签，并在纸上写下四个数量：找到的蛙鸣、漏掉的蛙鸣、误报，以及正确排除的背景。此时，两个原本看似相近的模型表现出了明显差异。一个发现更多蛙鸣，却要求她额外听大量片段；另一个提供更干净的筛选结果，却漏掉轻微蛙鸣。泰莎选择了与可用听音时间相匹配的验证标准，并单独报告漏检数量。她的评估终于开始描述科研中的实际用途，而不再只是一个漂亮的百分比。

concept.en: Accuracy measures the fraction of all predictions that are correct. Precision asks how many predicted positives are truly positive, while recall asks how many actual positives are found. Their denominators answer different questions, especially when the positive class is rare. F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, but it ignores true negatives and encodes a particular balance between the two quantities. No metric is universally best. Choose metrics that reflect the intended use, and retain the confusion-matrix counts so readers can reconstruct the tradeoffs.
concept.zh: 准确率衡量所有预测中正确预测所占的比例。精确率询问预测为正类的样本中有多少确实为正类，而召回率询问实际正类中有多少被找到。两者的分母回答不同问题，正类罕见时尤其如此。F1 是精确率与召回率的调和平均数，但它忽略真阴性，并隐含了这两个量之间的一种特定平衡。没有任何指标在所有场景中都是最优的。应选择符合预期用途的指标，并保留混淆矩阵计数，让读者能够重新判断各项取舍。

application.en: Report the positive-class definition, prevalence, threshold, and four confusion-matrix counts with your metrics. Compare against a simple baseline, including an always-negative classifier when appropriate. Use validation data to examine precision and recall across thresholds. Check important recording conditions separately, such as quiet versus windy evenings. When denominators are zero, state the undefined quantity or the explicit reporting convention instead of silently treating it as excellent performance.
application.zh: 报告指标时，同时写明正类定义、正类比例、阈值和混淆矩阵的四项计数。与简单基线比较，适当时也包括始终预测负类的分类器。使用验证数据检查不同阈值下的精确率和召回率。分别检查重要录音条件，例如安静与多风的夜晚。如果分母为零，应说明该量未定义，或明确采用的报告约定，而不是默默把它当成出色表现。

practice.en: The linked Google classification-metrics tutorial defines accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 and discusses how error priorities affect metric choice. Use that official framework to audit the original frog-detector example. Rebuild each metric from the four counts before drawing a conclusion, and explain why a high accuracy can coexist with no successful detections. The tutorial is the factual reference; the recording scenario and counts are original.
practice.zh: 所链接的 Google 分类指标教程定义了准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1，并讨论不同错误的重要性如何影响指标选择。可以用这个官方框架审查原创的蛙鸣检测器示例。在作出结论之前，根据四项计数重新构建各个指标，并解释为什么高准确率可能与一次成功检测都没有同时出现。教程是事实依据；录音情境和计数均为原创。

topics.formula:
N = TP + TN + FP + FN
Accuracy = (TP + TN) / N
Precision = TP / (TP + FP)
Recall = TP / (TP + FN)
F1 = 2 TP / (2 TP + FP + FN)

symbols.en: TP counts true positives: actual calls labeled as calls. TN counts true negatives: background clips labeled as background. FP counts false positives: background clips incorrectly labeled as calls. FN counts false negatives: actual calls that the detector misses. N is the total number of evaluated clips. Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1 name the four dimensionless metrics shown. Multiplication is implied in 2 TP. Each denominator must be checked before division; for example, precision is undefined when TP + FP is zero because no clips were predicted positive.
symbols.zh: TP 统计真阳性，即实际蛙鸣被标为蛙鸣。TN 统计真阴性，即背景片段被标为背景。FP 统计假阳性，即背景片段被错误地标为蛙鸣。FN 统计假阴性，即检测器漏掉的实际蛙鸣。N 是被评估片段的总数。Accuracy、Precision、Recall 和 F1 分别表示公式中的四个无量纲指标。2 TP 表示二乘以 TP。除法之前必须检查每个分母；例如，TP + FP 为零时，精确率未定义，因为没有任何片段被预测为正类。

calculation.en: Create one hundred labeled clips: ten contain calls and ninety contain background. Suppose a detector finds eight calls, misses two, and flags twelve background clips. Then TP = 8, FN = 2, FP = 12, and TN = 78. Accuracy is (8 + 78) / 100 = 86%. Precision is 8 / 20 = 40%, recall is 8 / 10 = 80%, and F1 is 16 / 30 ≈ 53.3%. An always-negative baseline reaches 90% accuracy because it rejects all ninety background clips, but its recall is zero. Its precision is undefined because it predicts no positives. Thus the detector has lower accuracy yet retrieves eight calls that the baseline misses. Whether twelve false alarms are acceptable depends on the intended listening workflow.
calculation.zh: 构造一百个带标签的片段：十个含有蛙鸣，九十个是背景。假设检测器找到八个蛙鸣、漏掉两个，并把十二个背景片段标为蛙鸣。那么 TP = 8、FN = 2、FP = 12、TN = 78。准确率为 (8 + 78) / 100 = 86%。精确率为 8 / 20 = 40%，召回率为 8 / 10 = 80%，F1 为 16 / 30 ≈ 53.3%。始终预测负类的基线可以达到 90% 的准确率，因为它排除了全部九十个背景片段，但其召回率为零。由于它没有预测任何正类，其精确率未定义。因此，检测器虽然准确率较低，却找回了基线漏掉的八个蛙鸣。十二次误报是否可以接受，取决于预期的听音流程。

limits.en: A confusion matrix describes one threshold on one evaluation set. Precision can change when the positive-class prevalence changes, even if other behavior appears similar. F1 does not express every cost preference. Small numbers of positives make recall estimates unstable, and a pooled score can hide poor performance in particular conditions.
limits.zh: 混淆矩阵描述的是某个评估集上某一阈值的表现。即使其他行为看起来相似，正类比例改变时，精确率也可能改变。F1 无法表达所有代价偏好。正类数量很少会使召回率估计不稳定，而汇总分数可能掩盖特定条件下的糟糕表现。

takeaway.en: Keep the confusion matrix close to every headline score; the right metric must reveal the errors that matter for the intended use.
takeaway.zh: 让混淆矩阵始终伴随主要分数；合适的指标必须揭示预期用途真正关心的错误。

title.en: Build rules, then understand what combining them changes
title.zh: 建立规则，再理解组合规则会改变什么

story.en: Niko tests paper kites with different wing angles and tail lengths. A linear classifier misses a pattern: long tails help at one wing angle but hurt at another. He draws a small decision tree that first asks about angle and then asks about tail length. The rules are easy to inspect, yet a deeper version memorizes nearly every flight and changes dramatically when one windy trial is removed. Niko limits the depth and compares the result with a collection of randomized trees. Their combined predictions vary less across his repeated training samples, although the model is harder to summarize as a single rule. He keeps a shallow tree for understanding and an ensemble as a candidate for prediction, evaluating both on flights reserved beforehand. More rules become useful only when they survive the same fair comparison.
story.zh: 尼科测试不同翼角和尾长的纸风筝。线性分类器遗漏了一个模式：长尾在某个翼角下有帮助，在另一个翼角下却有害。他画了一棵小型决策树，先询问翼角，再询问尾长。这些规则容易检查，但更深的版本几乎记住了每次飞行，而且只要移除一次多风条件下的试飞，整棵树就会大幅改变。尼科限制树深，并把结果与一组随机化树比较。在重复抽取训练样本时，组合预测的变化更小，但模型也更难概括成一条规则。他保留浅树用于理解，同时把集成模型作为预测候选；两者都使用事先预留的飞行记录进行评估。更多规则只有经得起同样公平的比较时，才真正有价值。

concept.en: A decision tree repeatedly divides feature space into regions and predicts from the examples in each leaf. For binary classification, Gini impurity measures how mixed a node's labels are; a candidate split is judged by the weighted impurity of its children. Deep trees can fit complicated patterns and also memorize noise. Random forests average predictions from randomized trees, often reducing variance. Boosting instead builds a sequence of learners that improve a chosen objective. Both are ensembles, but their training logic and tuning choices differ.
concept.zh: 决策树反复把特征空间划分为不同区域，并根据各个叶节点中的样本作出预测。对于二元分类，基尼不纯度衡量节点标签的混杂程度；候选划分依据子节点的加权不纯度进行评价。深树可以拟合复杂模式，也可能记住噪声。随机森林对随机化树的预测取平均，往往能够降低方差。提升法则依次建立学习器，以改善所选目标函数。两者都属于集成方法，但训练逻辑和调参选择不同。

application.en: Fit a shallow tree first and inspect its conditions against the data. Tune depth and minimum leaf size within validation, then compare a forest or boosted trees using identical splits and metrics. Examine stability across reasonable training variations. For interpretation, distinguish a useful predictive split from a causal explanation. Record whether an ensemble combines class votes or probabilities, since these can yield different decisions.
application.zh: 先拟合浅树，并对照数据检查其条件。在验证过程中调整深度与最小叶节点样本数，然后使用相同划分和指标比较森林或提升树。检查在合理的训练变动下结果是否稳定。进行解释时，应区分有用的预测划分与因果解释。记录集成模型组合的是类别投票还是概率，因为两者可能产生不同决策。

practice.en: The linked scikit-learn decision-tree guide demonstrates classification and regression trees and explains depth-related overfitting. Its ensemble guide distinguishes randomized forests from boosting and specifies that its forest classifier averages class probabilities. Those details ground the kite comparison and the averaging calculation below. They also explain why describing every forest implementation as a majority vote can obscure the actual prediction rule being used.
practice.zh: 所链接的 scikit-learn 决策树指南演示了分类树与回归树，并解释与深度相关的过拟合。其集成指南区分了随机化森林与提升法，并说明其森林分类器对类别概率取平均。这些细节支持了风筝模型比较以及下面的平均计算，也解释了为什么把所有森林实现都描述为多数投票，可能掩盖实际使用的预测规则。

topics.formula:
G(p) = 2 p (1 − p)
ΔG = G(p) − (n_L / n) G(p_L) − (n_R / n) G(p_R)
p_forest = (1 / T) Σₜ₌₁ᵀ qₜ

symbols.en: p is the positive-class fraction in a parent node and G is its binary Gini impurity. n is the parent sample count; n_L and n_R count samples sent to the left and right children, so n = n_L + n_R. p_L and p_R are their positive fractions. ΔG is the impurity reduction from that split. T is the number of trees, t indexes a tree, and qₜ is that tree's predicted positive probability for the same input. Σ adds these probabilities; p_forest is their unweighted average.
symbols.zh: p 是父节点中正类所占的比例，G 是其二元基尼不纯度。n 是父节点样本数；n_L 和 n_R 分别是送往左、右子节点的样本数，因此 n = n_L + n_R。p_L 和 p_R 是两个子节点的正类比例。ΔG 是该划分带来的不纯度下降。T 是树的数量，t 指定一棵树，qₜ 是这棵树对同一输入预测的正类概率。Σ 把这些概率相加；p_forest 是它们的未加权平均值。

calculation.en: A parent node contains six successful flights and four unsuccessful ones, so p = 0.6 and G = 2 × 0.6 × 0.4 = 0.48. A proposed split sends four successes and one failure left, and two successes and three failures right. The child impurities are 0.32 and 0.48. Each child has five examples, so weighted impurity is 0.5 × 0.32 + 0.5 × 0.48 = 0.40. The reduction is 0.08, a local improvement rather than proof of better test performance. Separately, suppose three trees predict positive probabilities 0.2, 0.7, and 0.9 for a new flight. Their average is 1.8 / 3 = 0.6, producing a positive decision at threshold 0.5. This probability average is the stated ensemble rule.
calculation.zh: 父节点包含六次成功飞行与四次失败，因此 p = 0.6，G = 2 × 0.6 × 0.4 = 0.48。一个候选划分把四次成功和一次失败送到左侧，把两次成功和三次失败送到右侧。两个子节点的不纯度分别为 0.32 和 0.48。每个子节点都有五个样本，因此加权不纯度为 0.5 × 0.32 + 0.5 × 0.48 = 0.40。不纯度下降了 0.08，这是局部改进，并不能证明测试性能更好。另一个独立示例中，假设三棵树对一次新飞行预测的正类概率分别为 0.2、0.7、0.9。其平均值为 1.8 / 3 = 0.6，在阈值为 0.5 时作出正类决策。这里明确使用的集成规则就是概率平均。

limits.en: Greedy splits optimize local choices and need not produce a globally optimal tree. Forests can still fail when many trees share the same misleading signal. Large ensembles require more resources and are harder to inspect. Feature importance describes model behavior under particular assumptions; it does not establish that changing a feature will change the outcome.
limits.zh: 贪心划分优化的是局部选择，不一定得到全局最优的树。如果许多树共享同一种误导性信号，森林仍可能失败。大型集成模型需要更多资源，也更难检查。特征重要性描述的是特定假设下的模型行为，并不能证明改变某个特征就会改变结果。

takeaway.en: Trees turn interactions into explicit regions; ensembles can stabilize predictions, but every added layer of complexity still needs validation on the intended task.
takeaway.zh: 树模型把交互作用转化为明确区域；集成方法可以稳定预测，但每增加一层复杂度，都仍需针对预期任务进行验证。

title.zh: 寻找结构，不凭空赋予标签

story.en: Imani measures the length, width, mass, and surface texture of stones collected along a river walk. She has no geological labels and wants a compact view of the collection. A clustering routine returns three groups, which she initially names as if they were established rock types. Looking more carefully, she sees that changing the units of mass reshapes the groups. She standardizes the measurements for a clearly stated comparison and uses principal component analysis to inspect the largest directions of variation. The plot reveals a broad size trend, while clustering proposes divisions within that representation. Imani replaces her confident labels with neutral group identifiers and compares representative stones by hand. The analysis now helps her form questions for further study. It does not magically supply the missing geological ground truth.
story.zh: 伊玛尼在河边散步时收集石头，并测量它们的长、宽、质量与表面纹理。她没有地质标签，希望用紧凑的方式观察整个收藏。一个聚类程序返回了三组，她起初把这些组命名得仿佛它们就是已经确定的岩石类型。仔细检查后，她发现只要改变质量的单位，分组就会变化。她为一个明确说明的比较目的标准化测量值，并使用主成分分析观察变化最大的方向。图中呈现出明显的大小趋势，而聚类则在这种表示中提出分组。伊玛尼把自信的类别名称改成中性的组编号，并亲自比较有代表性的石头。此时，分析开始帮助她提出进一步研究的问题，却不会神奇地补上缺失的地质真值。

concept.en: Clustering groups observations according to a chosen similarity structure. K-means minimizes the sum of squared distances from points to their assigned centroids, so feature units and cluster shape matter. Principal component analysis, or PCA, instead finds orthogonal directions that preserve the most variance in centered data. It produces coordinates, not class labels. PCA can precede clustering, but discarded low-variance directions may still contain meaningful distinctions. Both methods reveal structure relative to their assumptions; neither independently proves that a group corresponds to a natural category.
concept.zh: 聚类根据选定的相似性结构把观测分组。K 均值最小化各点到其所属质心的平方距离之和，因此特征单位和簇的形状都很重要。主成分分析（PCA）则在中心化数据中寻找保留最多方差的正交方向。它产生的是坐标，而不是类别标签。PCA 可以用于聚类之前，但被舍弃的低方差方向仍可能含有有意义的区别。两种方法揭示的都是相对于各自假设的结构；它们都不能单独证明某个分组对应自然类别。

application.en: Choose features and scaling according to the comparison you intend, and preserve the transformation for later observations. Inspect representative members of each cluster and compare several plausible cluster counts or initializations. For PCA, report retained variance and examine the component loadings. If the representation will feed a supervised model, fit it inside training folds. Use domain evidence to interpret groups rather than treating cluster identifiers as discovered truth.
application.zh: 根据希望进行的比较选择特征与缩放方式，并保留该转换以处理后续观测。检查各簇的代表性成员，比较几个合理的簇数或初始化方式。对于 PCA，应报告保留的方差，并检查主成分载荷。如果这种表示将输入监督模型，应在训练折内部拟合它。解释分组时使用领域证据，不要把簇编号当成已经发现的真相。

practice.en: The linked scikit-learn clustering guide describes the k-means objective and the shapes it handles poorly. The linked decomposition guide illustrates PCA with a lower-dimensional view of the Iris measurements and notes that PCA centers inputs without automatically scaling each feature. These official examples clarify the different jobs of grouping and projection. The river-stone story and rectangular dataset below are original illustrations of those distinctions.
practice.zh: 所链接的 scikit-learn 聚类指南描述了 K 均值目标，以及它不擅长处理的形状。所链接的分解指南用鸢尾花测量值的低维表示说明 PCA，并指出 PCA 会中心化输入，但不会自动逐特征缩放。这些官方示例澄清了分组与投影承担的不同任务。河边石头故事和下面的矩形数据集，都是说明这些区别的原创示例。

topics.formula:
J = Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ ‖xᵢ − μ_cᵢ‖²
S = (1 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (xᵢ − x̄)(xᵢ − x̄)ᵀ
S vⱼ = λⱼ vⱼ
r₁ = λ₁ / Σⱼ₌₁ᵈ λⱼ

symbols.en: n counts observations and i selects one. xᵢ is a vector of d features; cᵢ identifies its cluster and μ_cᵢ is that cluster's centroid. The squared norm ‖·‖² sums squared coordinate differences, and J is total within-cluster squared distance. x̄ is the mean vector. S is the covariance matrix using divisor n here. Superscript T transposes a vector, making the product an outer product. vⱼ is principal direction j and λⱼ its variance, ordered largest first. Σ denotes summation. r₁ is the variance fraction retained by the first component, assuming positive total variance.
symbols.zh: n 是观测数量，i 指定其中一个观测。xᵢ 是含 d 个特征的向量；cᵢ 表示其所属簇，μ_cᵢ 是该簇的质心。平方范数 ‖·‖² 对各坐标差的平方求和，J 是簇内平方距离总和。x̄ 是均值向量。S 是此处以 n 为分母的协方差矩阵。上标 T 表示向量转置，使该乘积成为外积。vⱼ 是第 j 个主方向，λⱼ 是对应方差，按从大到小排列。Σ 表示求和。在总方差为正的前提下，r₁ 是第一主成分保留的方差比例。

calculation.en: Consider four two-dimensional points: (0,0), (0,2), (4,0), and (4,2), with both axes already in comparable units. Two clusters divided by the first coordinate have centroids (0,1) and (4,1). Every point has squared distance 1 from its centroid, so J = 4. A single centroid at (2,1) gives squared distance 5 per point and J = 20. For PCA, subtract the mean (2,1). The population covariance matrix is diagonal with entries 4 and 1, so the first principal direction is (1,0), up to its arbitrary sign. It preserves 4 / (4 + 1) = 80% of total variance. Keeping one component discards the vertical distinction. Lower clustering loss and high retained variance describe geometry, not the correctness of imagined category labels.
calculation.zh: 考虑四个二维点：(0,0)、(0,2)、(4,0)、(4,2)，两个坐标轴已经使用可比单位。按第一个坐标分为两个簇后，质心为 (0,1) 和 (4,1)。每个点到所属质心的平方距离都是 1，因此 J = 4。如果只使用位于 (2,1) 的单个质心，则每个点的平方距离都是 5，J = 20。进行 PCA 时，先减去均值 (2,1)。总体协方差矩阵为对角矩阵，对角元素为 4 和 1，因此第一主方向为 (1,0)，方向符号可以任意反转。它保留了 4 / (4 + 1) = 80% 的总方差。只保留一个主成分会舍弃竖直方向上的区别。更低的聚类损失与更高的保留方差描述的是几何性质，而不是想象出来的类别标签是否正确。

limits.en: K-means can struggle with irregular shapes, unequal densities, and outliers; its objective also decreases as more clusters are allowed. PCA captures linear variance, which may reflect nuisance variation instead of useful signal. Scaling choices alter both analyses, and a visually separated projection does not establish a meaningful scientific distinction.
limits.zh: K 均值可能难以处理不规则形状、不同密度和离群值；允许更多簇时，其目标值也会下降。PCA 捕捉线性方差，而方差可能来自干扰变化，并非有用信号。缩放选择会改变两种分析，投影图中看起来分离也不能证明存在有意义的科学区别。

takeaway.en: Use clustering to propose groups and PCA to compress variation, then test your interpretation with evidence that neither method supplied.
takeaway.zh: 用聚类提出分组，用 PCA 压缩变化，再用这两种方法本身没有提供的证据检验解释。

title.en: Validate choices and prepare for a changing setting
title.zh: 验证模型选择，为场景变化做好准备

story.en: Ren models humidity in a small greenhouse using many correlated sensor readings. A flexible fit follows the first month almost perfectly, yet its estimates deteriorate on later days. He tries regularization to discourage large coefficients and compares strengths using folds that respect time. The model with the smallest training error no longer wins. After selecting a simpler candidate, he evaluates it on a final untouched period and records the result. Weeks later, new ventilation equipment changes the relationship between temperature and humidity. Ren sees that the old test result cannot promise performance under this new condition. He checks input ranges, obtains new labeled measurements, and reevaluates before relying on the model again. His notebook now treats validation as a decision process and monitoring as a continuing responsibility, with regularization helping only one part of the problem.
story.zh: 任使用许多相互相关的传感器读数，建立小型温室的湿度模型。一个灵活的拟合几乎完美追随了第一个月的数据，但在后续日期上的估计变差了。他尝试使用正则化抑制过大的系数，并通过尊重时间顺序的折划分比较不同强度。训练误差最小的模型不再获胜。选定较简单的候选模型后，他在最终一段未触碰的数据上评估并记录结果。几周后，新的通风设备改变了温度与湿度之间的关系。任意识到，旧测试结果不能保证新条件下的性能。他检查输入范围，获得新的带标签测量值，并在再次依赖模型之前重新评估。他的笔记现在把验证视为决策过程，把监测视为持续责任，而正则化只能帮助解决其中一部分问题。

concept.en: Validation estimates how a modeling choice performs beyond the examples used to fit it. Cross-validation repeats this comparison across splits, but the split structure must reflect dependencies and the intended use. L2 regularization adds a penalty for large coefficients, trading some training fit for a simpler parameter solution. Its strength is selected using validation, not the final test. Distribution shift means the future input or target relationship differs from the evaluated setting. Regularization can reduce overfitting without protecting against every shift, so a good development score remains conditional evidence.
concept.zh: 验证用于估计某项建模选择在拟合样本之外的表现。交叉验证在不同划分上重复这种比较，但划分结构必须反映数据依赖关系和预期用途。L2 正则化对大系数增加惩罚，用部分训练拟合效果换取更简单的参数解。其强度应通过验证选择，而不是通过最终测试选择。分布偏移意味着未来输入或输入与目标的关系不同于被评估的场景。正则化可以减轻过拟合，却无法防御所有偏移，因此良好的开发阶段分数仍只是附带条件的证据。

application.en: Define a modest set of candidate settings and compare them on the same validation folds. Place every learned preprocessing step inside each fold. Use group or chronological splits when the task requires them, and keep a final evaluation period untouched by selection. Record input ranges, class proportions when relevant, and error patterns. After deployment changes, obtain fresh labeled evidence rather than treating input monitoring alone as a performance measurement.
application.zh: 定义数量适中的候选设置，并在相同验证折上比较。把所有需要学习的预处理步骤放到每个折内部。任务需要时，使用分组或按时间划分，并保留最终评估时间段，不让它参与选择。记录输入范围、适用时的类别比例，以及误差模式。部署条件改变后，应获取新的带标签证据，不要把只监测输入当成性能测量。

practice.en: The linked scikit-learn cross-validation guide documents group-aware and time-ordered splitters. Its linear-model guide presents ridge regression and validation of regularization strength. The linked Google dataset guide also discusses mismatches between evaluation data and later use. These sources support the workflow, while the greenhouse narrative is original. Note that the averaged-loss objective below uses a different penalty normalization from scikit-learn Ridge's summed-loss convention. With otherwise matching conventions, the Ridge penalty parameter equals the training sample count times λ.
practice.zh: 所链接的 scikit-learn 交叉验证指南说明了考虑分组和时间顺序的划分器。其线性模型指南介绍岭回归，以及正则化强度的验证。所链接的 Google 数据集指南也讨论了评估数据与后续使用场景不匹配的问题。这些资料支持了所述流程，温室叙事则为原创。请注意，下方平均损失目标的惩罚归一化方式，与 scikit-learn Ridge 所采用的求和损失约定不同。 在其他约定一致的情况下，Ridge 的惩罚参数等于训练样本数量乘以 λ。

topics.formula:
L_λ(w,b) = (1 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (b + wᵀxᵢ − yᵢ)² + λ Σⱼ₌₁ᵈ wⱼ²
CV(λ) = (1 / K) Σₖ₌₁ᴷ MSEₖ(λ)

symbols.en: n is the training sample count; i indexes observations and j indexes d features. xᵢ is an input vector, yᵢ its target, w the coefficient vector, and b the unpenalized intercept. Superscript T denotes transpose, so wᵀxᵢ is a dot product. λ is a nonnegative penalty strength and L_λ the penalized training objective. Σ denotes summation. K is the number of validation folds and k selects one. MSEₖ is unpenalized error on fold k after fitting its corresponding training portion. CV is their unweighted mean; unequal fold sizes would require weights for a pooled per-example mean.
symbols.zh: n 是训练样本数；i 是观测下标，j 是 d 个特征中的特征下标。xᵢ 是输入向量，yᵢ 是目标，w 是系数向量，b 是不受惩罚的截距。上标 T 表示转置，因此 wᵀxᵢ 是点积。λ 是非负惩罚强度，L_λ 是带惩罚的训练目标。Σ 表示求和。K 是验证折的数量，k 指定其中一折。MSEₖ 是使用该折对应的训练部分拟合后，在该验证折上得到的不含惩罚项的误差。CV 是这些误差的未加权平均值；折大小不同时，若要得到按样本汇总的均值，需要加权。

calculation.en: Compare two synthetic coefficient vectors under the stated averaged-loss convention. Candidate A has training MSE 1.0 and squared coefficient sum 9; candidate B has training MSE 1.4 and squared coefficient sum 1. At λ = 0.1, their penalized objectives are 1.9 and 1.5, so B has the smaller objective despite worse raw training fit. This comparison illustrates the penalty and does not assert either vector is the optimized solution. Separately, suppose a validation search gives three equal-sized fold errors of 1.0, 1.4, and 1.2 for λ = 0, versus 0.9, 1.0, and 1.1 for λ = 0.1. Their means are 1.2 and 1.0. Choose the latter setting by validation, refit on development data, and evaluate once on the reserved final period.
calculation.zh: 在这里明确采用的平均损失约定下，比较两个合成系数向量。候选 A 的训练 MSE 为 1.0，系数平方和为 9；候选 B 的训练 MSE 为 1.4，系数平方和为 1。当 λ = 0.1 时，带惩罚的目标分别为 1.9 和 1.5，因此 B 虽然原始训练拟合较差，目标值却更小。这个比较只是说明惩罚项的作用，并未声称任一向量是优化后的解。另一个独立验证示例中，假设 λ = 0 在三个等大折上的误差为 1.0、1.4、1.2，而 λ = 0.1 时为 0.9、1.0、1.1。两者均值分别为 1.2 和 1.0。根据验证选择后一个设置，在开发数据上重新拟合，然后在保留的最终时间段上评估一次。

limits.en: Repeatedly searching many settings can overfit validation data. Cross-validation is not automatically valid for dependent observations or future forecasting. Regularization depends on feature scale and cannot supply missing information. Detecting a change in inputs does not prove accuracy fell, while stable input summaries do not guarantee that the target relationship remained stable.
limits.zh: 反复搜索大量设置可能使验证数据也发生过拟合。对于相互依赖的观测或未来预测，交叉验证并非自动有效。正则化依赖特征尺度，也无法提供缺失信息。发现输入变化并不能证明准确性下降；输入汇总统计稳定，也不能保证与目标的关系保持稳定。

takeaway.en: Use validation to choose complexity, reserve testing for the completed choice, and gather fresh evidence whenever the intended prediction setting changes.
takeaway.zh: 用验证选择复杂度，用保留测试评估已经完成的选择；只要预期预测场景改变，就收集新的证据。

title.zh: 数据集：划分原始数据集

title.en: Logistic regression: Calculating a probability with the sigmoid function
title.zh: 逻辑回归：使用 sigmoid 函数计算概率

title.en: Classification: Accuracy, recall, precision, and related metrics
title.zh: 分类：准确率、召回率、精确率与相关指标

title.en: Ensembles: Gradient boosting, random forests, bagging, voting, stacking
title.zh: 集成：梯度提升、随机森林、装袋、投票与堆叠

title.en: Decomposing signals in components: Principal component analysis
title.zh: 把信号分解为成分：主成分分析
交叉验证：评估估计器性能

title.en: Linear Models: Ridge regression and classification
title.zh: 线性模型：岭回归与分类

body.en: State the prediction time and holdout unit. Fit preprocessing only on training data, and check identities, duplicates, and future-derived features.
body.zh: 写明预测时点与留出单位。仅在训练数据上拟合预处理，并检查身份、重复记录和由未来信息衍生的特征。

body.en: Calculate errors before trusting a regression score. MSE emphasizes large mistakes; RMSE restores target units. Neither makes a coefficient causal.
body.zh: 信任回归分数之前，先计算误差。MSE 强调大错误，RMSE 恢复目标单位。两者都不能使系数具有因果意义。

body.en: Use training statistics for scaling, evaluate gradients at the same old parameters, and inspect both training and validation curves.
body.zh: 使用训练统计量进行缩放，在同一组旧参数上计算梯度，同时检查训练与验证曲线。

body.en: A probability and a threshold play different roles. Select the threshold on validation data and state the positive class and tie convention.
body.zh: 概率与阈值承担不同作用。在验证数据上选择阈值，并说明正类与恰好等于阈值时的处理约定。

body.en: Report true positives, true negatives, false positives, and false negatives. Check prevalence and denominators before interpreting accuracy, precision, recall, or F1.
body.zh: 报告真阳性、真阴性、假阳性与假阴性。解释准确率、精确率、召回率或 F1 之前，先检查正类比例与分母。

body.en: Limit tree complexity and compare ensembles on the same split. Local impurity reduction and feature importance do not establish causality.
body.zh: 限制树的复杂度，并在相同划分上比较集成模型。局部不纯度下降与特征重要性都不能确立因果关系。

body.en: Clusters propose groups; principal components preserve variance. Scaling changes both, and neither supplies the missing scientific labels.
body.zh: 簇提出分组，主成分保留方差。缩放会改变两者，而它们都无法提供缺失的科学标签。

title.zh: 把泛化结论视为附带条件

body.en: Tune regularization with appropriate validation, then test the finished choice. When the setting changes, collect fresh labels and reevaluate.
body.zh: 用适当的验证调整正则化，再测试完成后的选择。场景改变时，收集新的标签并重新评估。
